title: ADKM

# 💀 ADKM by Anoosh 💀

Are you ready for the ultimate survival challenge? **ADKM by Anoosh** introduces a terrifying, giant entity into your Minecraft world. He wanders the lands, carrying a massive, blood-red scythe, waiting for someone foolish enough to challenge him. He won't attack unless provoked—but once you hit him, the real nightmare begins.

---

## ✨ Features

* **🌍 World-Wide Threat:** The ADKM giant naturally spawns anywhere across the overworld. Watch your step during your travels!
* **⚔️ A True Boss Fight:** He is neutral at first, but if you attack him, prepare for a brutal battle. With an insanely high health pool and devastating attack power, defeating him will require your best gear and strategy.
* **🛑 Legendary Loot:** If you manage to survive and conquer this giant, he will drop his iconic weapon—the **Scythe**. This weapon deals a massive **+16 Attack Damage**, making it one of the most powerful tools in your arsenal!
* **🎨 Dark Anime Aesthetic:** Features a high-quality 3D pixel art model with a grim reaper vibe, glowing orange eyes, a Punisher-style skull shirt, and a beautifully detailed scythe.

---

## 🛠️ Installation & Support
1. Download and install the required library mod (see below).
2. Download the correct version of **ADKM by Anoosh** for your Mod Loader (Forge/Fabric/NeoForge).
3. Drop both `.jar` files into your Minecraft `mods` folder.
4. Launch the game and prepare yourself to face the giant!

---

## ⛔ Requirements (🚨 VERY IMPORTANT 🚨)

To make sure the animations and models for ADKM work properly without crashing, you **MUST** install the following dependency:

* **[GeckoLib on CurseForge](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/geckolib)**
* **[GeckoLib on Modrinth](https://modrinth.com/mod/geckolib/versions)**

*Note: Please ensure you download the version of GeckoLib that exactly matches your game version and mod loader!*
